claims: The 98th Academy Awards are on March 15, 2026.

The 98th Academy Awards start at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.

FuboTV carries the broadcast of the 98th Academy Awards.
DirecTV Stream carries the broadcast of the 98th Academy Awards.

On-demand content from the 98th Academy Awards is available on ABC.com the day after the ceremony.
